628-2018-5073.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Tinder Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Tinder Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

586-4668-5258-5618-8095.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least one card this turn.
586-4668-5258-5618-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

586-5258-5618-6495-6967.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
586-5258-5618-6495-6967.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6754-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

647-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-7297.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-7297.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7237.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
6798-6972-7237.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Voracious Wurm.
When Voracious Wurm dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

6758-7283.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack.
6758-7283.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
6758-7283.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Dawnsire, dealing 100 damage to Raphael.
Raphael triggers, adding 100 {R}.

1020-2866-4050-6556.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
1020-2866-4050-6556.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding one mana of any color.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding one mana of any color.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

1409-2097-5418.description:
Activate Exhibition Magician by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Exhibition Magician enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Exhibition Magician.
Resolve the Exhibition Magician trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

579-1251-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
579-1251-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G} due to Mana Reflection.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3140-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
3140-6556-7070.description:
Activate Soltari Guerrillas by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Soltari Guerrillas.
The Soltari Guerrillas ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Soltari Guerrillas from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-4716.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

3908-5775-7009.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
3908-5775-7009.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
3908-5775-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Spark Double, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. At end of combat, Fortune triggers, blinking it and Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat each turn.

2092-3918-4131.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying at most {2}, untapping it.
Repeat

198-304-1978.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Tough Cookie.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-304-1978.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

1492-1661-2854-4574.easyPrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1492-1661-2854-4574.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-1661-2854-4574.description:
Cast Welding Jar either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

431-1308-3129-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-3129-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

539-3045-3293-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand with the mana to cast it.
You have a creature card in your graveyard.
539-3045-3293-5147.description:
Cast any creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters as a Plains due to Ashaya and Emeria Shepherd, Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature cast in step 1.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
539-3045-3293-5147.notes: You can forego step 3 as long as two or more creature cards are in your graveyard. This allows you to reanimate all creature cards in your graveyard if you wish.

2457-3000-4289-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Squirrel and Insect by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

880-2757-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping a basic land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2085-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
2085-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Kelpie Guide do not have summoning sickness.
2085-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1129-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Harabaz Druid does not have summoning sickness. You control at least four Allies.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Harabaz Druid
1129-5200.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Harabaz Druid
Repeat.
1129-5200.notes:
Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.
Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

678-2034-2506-5130.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional artifact, enchantment and/or token.
"Dragon" chosen with Molten Echoes.
678-2034-2506-5130.description:
Cast Realm-Scorcher Hellkite by paying {4}{R}{R} and sacrificing an additional artifact, enchantment or token.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes triggers.
Resolve the Realm-Scorcher Hellkite trigger, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Realm-Scorcher Hellkite.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Realm-Scorcher Hellkite, adding {C}{C}.
When Realm-Scorcher Hellkite dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

2440-2609-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Soldiers.
2440-2609-3263.description:
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {1} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

776-1329-4497.notablePrerequisites:
You control a noncreature nontoken artifact that can be cast using only red mana.
Slobad and Emry do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-4497.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping and sacrificing the artifact, adding an amount of {R} equal to the artifact's mana value.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast the artifact from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers twice.
Resolve the first Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, giving creatures you control +1/+1 until end of turn and untapping them.
Resolve the second Jeskai Ascendancy trigger, causing you to loot.
Repeat.

2169-2831-4050.description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Glen Elendra Archmage, adding one mana of any color.
When Glen Elendra Archmage dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter on it.
The two counters are removed from Glen Elendra  as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Once you have infinite mana, you amy activate Zameck Guildmage's abilities any number of times.

334-1395-4598-5195.description:
Cast Essence Flux either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {U}, targeting Bloodwater Entity.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Bloodwater Entity.
Bloodwater Entity enters the battlefield, putting Essence Flux on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2034-3599-4867.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {C}{C}.
Cormela dies, returning Goryo's Vengeance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Goryo's Vengeance by paying {1}{B}, putting Cormela from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

63-4499-4659.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Wernog.
Wernog leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering twice.
Resolve both of Wernog's triggers, creating at least two Clue tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing two Clue tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

186-1308-2713-3883-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {U}, causing an opponent to draw a card.
Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {U}.
Repeat.

280-1479-2692.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-2692.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Felidar Retreat, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

225-539-2248-3861.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Skyshroud Ranger as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

618-2440-3930.notablePrerequisites: You control at least 4 snow permanents.
618-2440-3930.description:
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a token copy of Rimewind Taskmage with haste.
Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each human and/or wizard you control.
Tap the Rimewind Taskmage token for {1}to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat for infinite colorless mana, ETB, and tapped creature tokens with haste.

1267-3745-4600.notablePrerequisites:
Identity Thief does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents can not block and kill Identity Thief.
1267-3745-4600.description:
Declare Identity Thief as an attacker.
Identity Thief triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless, becoming a copy of it until end of turn and Return Medomai from exile to the battlefield at end of turn.
Deal combat damage with Identity Thief, causing you to take an additional turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Identity Thief triggers, returning Medomai from exile to the battlefield.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
